task.title: Fail provider-tool task turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/577 by retaining a caller-owned failure diagnostic across bounded provider/tool task turns while keeping final provider text as Attempt evidence only.
acceptance_criteria: Expose failure-specific initial and continuation operations that retain the validated caller diagnostic.
Keep tool responses non-terminal and require explicit progression with fresh caller-owned identity and authorization.
On a final response, persist assistant content and an exact Attempt before failing the task with the original diagnostic.
Test reopened projections, chained tool progression, ordered partial commits, and authoritative terminal races.

attempts.summary: Established RED for initial and continued failure turns.
attempts.diagnostic: ToolAssistantRuntime lacked failure-specific outcomes and operations capable of retaining a caller-owned diagnostic through provider/tool continuations.
attempts.patch: Added focused failing tests for direct final failure, one-tool continuation, and chained explicit tool steps.

attempts.diagnostic: Failure-specific outcomes preserve the exact caller diagnostic while delegating each bounded provider/tool step to the existing attempt-only runtime path.
attempts.patch: Added failure outcomes and continuations, initial and continuation methods, persistence tests, documentation, and milestone status.

attempts.summary: Strengthened chained persistence evidence from substantive review.
attempts.diagnostic: The chained final test asserted returned state but did not independently reopen and compare the durable session and failed task projections.
attempts.patch: Reloaded and compared both final projections after the multi-step failure continuation.

attempts.summary: Verified exact head and merged after review cooldowns.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused failure tests, pinned verification, and independent review passed. Rust quality gate run 30149736539 succeeded, and substantive CodeRabbit review completed on exact head with zero unresolved threads after rate-limited false greens.
attempts.patch: Pull request 578 squash-merged as b2318a926af1fb4cfec29f9dc3043f952e291e57 and closed issue 577.

outcome.summary: Provider-tool task turns can now retain caller-owned failure intent and diagnostics across explicit tool steps, then durably fail after recording final provider content only as Attempt evidence.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test tool_task_runtime # focused failure tests passed
Independent pre-commit review # no final actionable findings
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30149736539 and substantive CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/578

lessons: Failure diagnostics remain caller-owned terminal data; provider output is execution evidence and must not be promoted into the diagnostic.
Typed continuations preserve failure intent across multiple bounded tool steps without duplicating dispatch logic.
Reopen assertions are especially important for terminal paths assembled from several explicit calls.
A successful quality gate cannot compensate for a false-green rate-limited review.
